metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1974 · Chinatown
metas.description: A private detective hired to expose an adulterer in 1930s Los Angeles finds himself caught up in a web of deceit, corruption, and murder.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1976 · All the President's Men
metas.description: "The Washington Post" reporters Bob Woodward and Carl Bernstein uncover the details of the Watergate scandal that leads to President Richard Nixon's resignation.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1972 · Sleuth
metas.description: A man who loves games and theater invites his wife's lover to meet him, setting up a battle of wits with potentially deadly results.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1970 · The Red Circle
metas.description: After leaving prison, master thief Corey crosses paths with a notorious escapee and an alcoholic former policeman. The trio proceed to plot an elaborate heist.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1978 · Dawn of the Dead
metas.description: During an escalating zombie epidemic, two Philadelphia SWAT team members, a traffic reporter and his TV executive girlfriend seek refuge in a secluded shopping mall.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1973 · The Day of the Jackal
metas.description: In the aftermath of France allowing Algeria's independence, a group of resentful military veterans hire a professional assassin codenamed "Jackal" to kill President Charles de Gaulle.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1978 · Halloween
metas.description: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to the small town of Haddonfield, Illinois, to kill again.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1971 · Dirty Harry
metas.description: When a killer calling himself "Scorpio" menaces San Francisco, tough-as-nails Police Inspector "Dirty" Harry Callahan is assigned to track down the crazed psychopath.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1974 · The Conversation
metas.description: A paranoid, secretive surveillance expert has a crisis of conscience when he suspects that the couple he is spying on will be murdered.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1977 · Sorcerer
metas.description: Four unfortunate men from different parts of the globe agree to risk their lives transporting gallons of nitroglycerin across dangerous Latin American jungle.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1972 · Deliverance
metas.description: Intent on seeing the Cahulawassee River before it's dammed and turned into a lake, outdoor fanatic Lewis Medlock takes his friends on a canoeing trip they'll never forget into the dangerous American back-country.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1973 · Enter the Dragon
metas.description: A Shaolin monk travels to an island fortress to spy on an opium lord - who is also a former monk from his temple - under the guise of attending a martial arts tournament.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1971 · Duel
metas.description: A business commuter is pursued and terrorized by the malevolent driver of a massive tractor-trailer.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1974 · The Taking of Pelham One Two Three
metas.description: Four armed men hijack a New York City subway car and demand a ransom for the passengers. The city's police are faced with a conundrum: Even if it's paid, how could they get away?

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1979 · The Warriors
metas.description: Members of a street gang known as the Warriors must fight their way from the Bronx to their home turf on Coney Island when they are falsely accused of assassinating a respected gang leader.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1973 · The Wicker Man
metas.description: A puritan police sergeant arrives in a Scottish island village in search of a missing girl, who the pagan locals claim never existed.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1976 · The Tenant
metas.description: A bachelor man rents a Parisian apartment whose previous tenant committed suicide, and slowly finds himself drawn into a rabbit hole of dangerous paranoia.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1975 · Deep Red
metas.description: A jazz pianist and a wisecracking journalist are pulled into a complex web of mystery after the former witnesses the brutal murder of a psychic.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1976 · Marathon Man
metas.description: After the murder of his older brother, a New York history student is hounded by shadowy government agents on the trail of a Nazi war criminal who is trying to retrieve smuggled diamonds.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1975 · Three Days of the Condor
metas.description: A bookish CIA researcher in Manhattan finds all his co-workers dead, and must outwit those responsible until he figures out who he can really trust.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1971 · Straw Dogs
metas.description: A young American and his English wife come to rural England and face increasingly vicious local harassment.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1972 · Frenzy
metas.description: A serial murderer is strangling women with a necktie. The London police have a suspect, but he is the wrong man.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1979 · And Justice for All
metas.description: A lawyer is forced to defend a judge, while defending other clients, and trying to find punishment for the guilty and provide justice for the innocent.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1979 · The China Syndrome
metas.description: A reporter finds what appears to be a cover-up of safety hazards at a nuclear power plant.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1975 · The Passenger
metas.description: Unable to find the war he has been asked to cover, a frustrated war correspondent takes the risky path of co-opting the identity of a dead arms-deal acquaintance.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1976 · Assault on Precinct 13
metas.description: A highway patrol officer, two criminals, and a station secretary defend a defunct Los Angeles precinct office against a siege by a bloodthirsty street gang.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1971 · Get Carter
metas.description: When his brother dies under mysterious circumstances in a car accident, London gangster Jack Carter travels to Newcastle to investigate.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1972 · The Getaway
metas.description: A recently-released ex-con and his loyal wife go on the run after a heist goes awry.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1971 · The Andromeda Strain
metas.description: Top scientists work feverishly in a secret, state-of-the-art laboratory to discover what killed the citizens of a small town and how the deadly contagion can be stopped.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1971 · Vanishing Point
metas.description: During the 1970s, car-delivery driver Kowalski delivers hot rods in record time, but always runs into trouble.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1973 · Mean Streets
metas.description: In New York City's Little Italy, a devoutly Catholic mobster must reconcile his desire for power, his feelings for his epileptic girlfriend, and his devotion to his troublesome friend.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1974 · Black Christmas
metas.description: During their Christmas break, a group of sorority girls are stalked by a stranger.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1971 · Klute
metas.description: A small-town detective searching for a missing man has only one lead: a connection with a New York prostitute.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 1974 · The Parallax View
metas.description: An ambitious reporter gets in way-over-his-head trouble while investigating a senator's assassination which leads to a vast conspiracy involving a multinational corporation behind every event in the world's headlines.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1977 · The Spy Who Loved Me
metas.description: James Bond investigates the hijacking of British and Russian submarines carrying nuclear warheads, with the help of a K.G.B. agent whose lover he killed.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1974 · The Towering Inferno
metas.description: At the opening party of a colossal San Francisco skyscraper, a massive fire breaks out due to careless building practices by the contractor, threatening to destroy the tower and everyone in it.
